_comment: Body app, Recover tab, Sauna & cold (and massage). Saunas, cold plunges, float tanks, recovery studios and massage in and near Burlington. Prices and hours as published on each business's own site or its own booking page on the date in 'verified'; 'verified' is null when the address and at least one price could not both be confirmed there. Yoga studios live in gyms.json (kind 'yoga'); 'yoga_studios' below points at them so this tab can list them without a second copy.

spots.name: Savu Sauna Lakeside
spots.offers: Wood-fired lakeside sauna rented privately by the hour, plus a weekly community session (Hula Happy Hour) where you sweat, dip in Lake Champlain, and rest.

prices.item: Hula Happy Hour community session (Tue and Wed, 5:30 to 6:30 pm)

spots.hours: Mon to Thu 12 to 8; Fri to Sun 9 to 8
unverified: season: no season or winter schedule published on the Lakeside page
zip code: site gives street and town only
private session base capacity: booking page does not say how many people the $77 base price covers
spots.notes: Book ahead online. Bring your own towel and water bottle for Hula Happy Hour; six people per sauna. Robes and towels available as add-ons for private sessions. Savu also runs saunas in Jeffersonville and Waitsfield. Savu's planned bathhouse at 208 Flynn Ave (reported by Seven Days for fall 2026) is not mentioned on savu.cc, so do not list it as open.

spots.name: Stella Blue Sauna Co. (Pine Street sessions)
spots.address: 377 Pine St, Burlington, VT 05401 (The Pinery); mobile rentals delivered elsewhere
spots.offers: Mobile wood-fired cedar sauna for 6 to 8 people. Book a shared public 50-minute sauna slot or a private buyout at The Pinery on Pine Street, or rent the sauna delivered to your site.

prices.item: Public Sauna Club, 50 minutes, per person
Private sauna buyout, 50 minutes, up to 8 people
Delivered rental, weekday 24 hours (Mon to Thu)
Delivered rental, weekend 24 hours (Fri to Sun)

unverified: hours: no fixed schedule published; open slots appear only on the booking calendar
season: not stated; I did not confirm that Pine Street slots are open this winter
spots.notes: Swimsuit or athletic attire required; bring a towel, water bottle and slides. Under 18 must be with an adult and a guardian signs the waiver. Based in Hinesburg; delivery free within 20 miles of Hinesburg, $3.50 per mile beyond. Community socials announced on Instagram.

spots.name: Northern Kin Sauna Co.
spots.offers: Mobile sauna delivered and set up at your location, plus occasional pop-up community sauna rituals and sauna socials.

prices.item: Cold plunge, 15 minutes (listed on booking page)

unverified: prices: mobile sauna rental and event ticket prices not published
hours: no public session schedule posted on the events page today
season: not stated
spots.notes: Based in Charlotte, serving Burlington and surrounding towns. Event dates are posted via the booking page and Instagram @kin.ritual; none were listed when checked.

spots.name: Float Away Wellness Spa
spots.offers: Private Epsom-salt float suites with in-room showers, plus a vibroacoustic lounge and combo sessions.
spots.hours: Wed to Sun 9 am to 6 pm; closed Mon and Tue
unverified: season: 'Year round' inferred from fixed weekly hours, not stated outright
spots.notes: By appointment only; book online. Owner bought the tanks from the former Satori float spa in Shelburne, which has closed.

spots.name: Bijou Blu Medical & Wellness
spots.offers: Cold plunge and hot tub contrast therapy, Sunlighten infrared sauna, Rapid Reboot compression boots, localized cryotherapy, cupping, and massage. Also IV drips and cosmetic cryo facials.

prices.item: Recovery membership, 8 sessions a month (cold plunge, sauna, compression)

spots.hours: Mon 10 to 2; Tue 12 to 6; Wed and Thu 10 to 6; Fri 10 to 4; Sat 9 to 1; Sun closed
unverified: prices: the site contradicts itself. Infrared sauna is $35 on the pricing page but $42 on its own page; localized cryo is $40 on pricing but $28 on its page; deep tissue is $155 on pricing but $135 on the massage page. Confirm at booking
regular (non-first-time) cold plunge price not published
season: inferred from weekly hours
spots.notes: Older listings put Bijou Blu at 10 Farrell St; its own site now says 234 Market St. No whole-body cryo chamber is advertised; cryo here is localized (wand) and cosmetic. Wellness Wednesday: $25 cold plunge, infrared sauna or compression. Books via Vagaro. 24-hour cancellation on massages.

spots.name: Tight Club Williston
spots.address: 135 Allen Brook Ln, Suite 102, Williston, VT 05495
spots.offers: Fascia and lymphatic studio using targeted cryo-stimulation, red light, vibration plate and manual fascia work, aimed at pain, injury recovery and body contouring.

prices.item: PainRx targeted cryo, one area, 60 minutes

spots.hours: Mon 8 to 5; Wed 8 to 5; Fri 8:30 to 5; closed Tue, Thu, Sat, Sun
unverified: season: inferred from weekly hours
spots.notes: Part of a multi-location Tight Club brand. Treatments are booked appointments, not drop-in. Health claims on the booking page are the studio's own.

spots.name: The Spa at The Essex
spots.offers: Resort spa with massage menu, saunas, steam rooms, indoor pool, hot tub and relaxation lounges. Day passes available.

prices.price: $175 Sun to Thu, $185 Fri and Sat, plus 22% service charge
$200 Sun to Thu, $210 Fri and Sat, plus 22% service charge

prices.item: Spa amenity access add-on with a treatment (saunas, steam, pools, lounges)

prices.price: $60 Mon to Wed, $75 Thu to Sun

spots.hours: Spa Mon to Wed 10 am to 6 pm; Thu to Sun 8 am to 8 pm
unverified: day pass price: the treatments page also shows a $50 figure, conflicting with $60/$75
day pass contents: the pass description lists fitness center, pools, hot tub and lounges but does not name the sauna or steam explicitly
hot tub status: site says closed for repairs reopening 'Friday, January 9th', which looks stale
spots.notes: Steam rooms, saunas and spa lounges are 16 and older; under 18 must be with a parent or guardian. Treatment prices exclude a 22% service charge. Wellness Pass members get $99 massages Sunday to Thursday.

spots.name: Oasis Day Spa
spots.offers: Full-service day spa: Swedish, deep tissue, hot stone, prenatal and chair massage, reflexology, soft pack (dry) float body treatments, facials and salon services.
spots.hours: Mon 9 am to 4 pm; Tue to Sat 8:30 am to 7 pm; Sun closed
unverified: season: inferred from weekly hours
spots.notes: Its soft pack float is a warm dry-float body treatment, not a saltwater float tank. Same building as Float Away. Says it has won Seven Days readers' Best Day Spa every year 2015 to 2026.

spots.name: Rod Cain Massage Therapy
spots.address: 1 Mill St, Suites 224 and 242, Burlington, VT 05401
spots.offers: Multi-therapist studio in the Chace Mill focused on deep tissue, sports and rehabilitative massage; also Swedish, prenatal and couples.
unverified: hours: not published; booking is online through Vagaro
spots.notes: Free parking at the Chace Mill. Hot towels included. Texting 802-355-5585 is the studio's preferred contact.

spots.name: Green Mountain Massage & Bodywork
spots.offers: Team of therapists offering custom massage, short tune-ups, cupping and other bodywork, with a no-questions-asked sliding scale.
unverified: hours: not published; availability only on the Acuity calendar
spots.notes: Good budget pick: the sliding scale lets you pay a set minimum with no proof of income. 24 hours notice required to cancel. Some directories list 215 College St or 148 College St; its own site says 209 College St.

spots.name: Homebody Massage + Yoga
spots.offers: Small practice offering relaxation and therapeutic massage, Reiki and Abhyanga, with nervous-system-focused bodywork.
unverified: zip code: not on site
which therapists offer relaxation vs therapeutic sessions at the Burlington location: booking page mixes Burlington and Montpelier calendars
spots.notes: Second-floor office with stairs; off-street parking. 24-hour cancellation policy; late arrivals are not extended. Also has a Montpelier location.

spots.name: SOMA VT (massage therapy)
spots.offers: Training gym with an orthopedic massage therapist: sports and deep tissue massage, active release, cupping, kinesio taping.
unverified: hours: not published; booking through Mindbody
spots.notes: Sports and injury focus, aimed at lifters and athletes. You do not need to be a gym member to book, as far as the page shows, but it does not say so explicitly.

spots.name: Thrive Movement
spots.address: 255 South Champlain St, 2nd Floor, Burlington, VT 05401
spots.offers: Therapeutic, sports and orthopedic massage from a movement therapist, with IASTM, myofascial release and active release available.
spots.hours: Mon 9 to 7; Tue 9 to 4:30; Wed 9 to 7; Thu 9 to 4:30; Fri 10 to 5; Sat closed; Sun 11 to 5
unverified: season: inferred from weekly hours
spots.notes: Good fit for injury or mobility problems; massage can be paired with movement therapy.

spots.name: Cynthea's Spa
spots.offers: Downtown day spa with Swedish, deep tissue, aromatherapy, sports, prenatal and couples massage, plus facials, waxing and nails.
unverified: prices: the massage page lists durations (30, 60, 90 minutes) but no prices; the Booker service menu did not load without JavaScript
hours: not found on site
zip code: not on massage page
spots.notes: Has a couples suite. Gratuities must be left in cash only. Phone 802-238-7524.
